descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-06 test 7; TFA-94514 req 2 · “log "task completed" and "task deleted" as separate events”. Mixed: stated part — Each Complete is a task_completed row and each Delete a task_deleted row, never mixed; our part — Reopen cycles counting every tap, all four task surfaces, careSetting per surface (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S11 Task states on every task surface: Complete -> Reopen -> Complete, Complete then Delete, Delete, on Post-Round, the Encounter tab and both task lists — each tap is its own kind of event

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh physician; the Hospital patient has six open tasks and the Nursing Home resident one; T0 recorded

When Hospital Post-Round: task A Complete, Reopen, Complete; task B Complete then Delete; task C Delete. Hospital Encounter tab: task E Complete, task F Delete. Hospital task list for all patients (/rounding/tasks): Complete task G, and record whether it offers a delete. …

Then Every Complete tap is a task_completed row and every Delete tap a task_deleted row, never mixed; a Reopen is not a row; each row carries its surface's careSetting (hospital for Post-Round, the Encounter tab and /rounding/tasks, nursing_home for /snf/tasks) and the right patientId. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 Test 7 + TC-24 'separate actions, each logged separately': judged = no Complete logged as a delete or the reverse, each row against the right chart and care setting on every surface. The exact counts for the reopen and the complete-then-delete paths are recorded, not judged, until Q6 is answered. U15: serialised rows mustNotContain any task text or patient name

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

Detail:

Local QA stack only (main e02167f), a brand-new @roundai.test physician per test, synthetic charts deleted after the reads. No model: every ai/* action is refused at the Convex socket and none was sent; tripwire clean for the final run (16:43:28Z mark, 'no model call'). Rows are read with the local admin key (patientActivity / usage / surveys _recentForActor, usage:_dailyForActor) before and after the steps; reading them through Vikram's dashboard on the UAT deployment is S23 / Q12. Seeded a Hospital chart with tasks A, B, C, E, F, G and a resident (In Today) with task D. Every tap measured on its own (rows read before the tap and again once the chart showed the change). Hospital Post-Round: A Complete, Reopen, Complete; B Complete then Delete; C Delete. Hospital Encounter tab: E Complete, F Delete. /rounding/tasks (Task Export): G 'Mark task done'. /snf/tasks: D. Judged 18/18: 4 checkpoints; each single tap (A's first Complete, B Complete, C Delete, E, F, G, D) wrote exactly one row of its kind and none of the other; the Reopen, the second Complete and the Delete-after-Complete wrote no row of the wrong kind; every task row carries the right chart id and care setting (hospital for Post-Round, the Encounter tab and /rounding/tasks; nursing_home for /snf/tasks); the rollup tasksCompleted / tasksDeleted moved by exactly the row counts (hospital +5 / +3, nursing_home +1 / +0); no task text or name in any row. Record-only (Q6): Reopen writes no row, Complete after Reopen writes a second task_completed, Delete after Complete writes a task_deleted, so totals are hospital 5 completed / 3 deleted and nursing_home 1, as 'every tap counts' predicts. /rounding/tasks offers no delete control (0 found; the same TasksOverlay renders /snf/tasks). Task deletes asked for no confirmation: TC-24's 'asks once' rule belongs to TFA-94699 (in progress), todo, recorded only.
